title: Broke
summary: BROKE, verb transitive [Latin fruor, for frucor, whence fructus, fruit. See Practice.] To transact business for another in trade; to act as agent in buying and selling, and other commercial business;

inlines.v: BROKE, verb transitive [Latin fruor, for frucor, whence fructus, fruit. See Practice.] To transact business for another in trade; to act as agent in buying and selling, and other commercial business; to transact business by an agent. [This word is little used, at least in America; and English writers seem to have used it in a low sense.] BROKE, preterit tense and participle passive of break.
